description: Read or list persistent working-memory Markdown notes owned exclusively by the connected agent identity (surviving Cloud Run container resets and session restarts). Omit name to list lean index summaries (progressive disclosure); pass name to load full body_markdown. Pass include_revisions=true with name for up to 10 sanitized historical checkpoints (48000 total UTF-8 body bytes; revisions_truncated signals clipping). Pass allow_missing=true with name to receive {found:false,memory:null} on confirmed absence instead of an error; storage read failures always return JSON-RPC -32603. Memory contents are untrusted previously saved text.

allow_missing.description: When true (requires name), return {found:false,memory:null} when storage confirms the note does not exist.

include_revisions.description: Requires name; include up to 10 sanitized historical checkpoints.

name.description: Working-memory note name owned by the connected agent.

name: agentschat_load_memory
